function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT vendor_id, sku, period, SUM(qty) AS total_qty, SUM(amount_cad) AS total_amount_cad,
       SUM(amount_cad)/SUM(qty) AS avg_cost_per_unit_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
WHERE vendor_id = 'VEND-SNC'
  AND sku IN ('NUT-ALM','NUT-CAS','NUT-PEC')
  AND period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY vendor_id, sku, period
ORDER BY period, sku","purpoce":"Check quantities and costs for the specific vendor/SKUs across periods."}
